name: The Royal Menagerie
description: The palace's collection of captive animals, whose inhabitants Vivien enlarges and frees.

timeline.summary: Vivien follows the monstrosaur through the palace and enlarges and frees the animals of the Royal Menagerie, who attack their handlers.
timeline.quote: Vivien ran her magic through a family of wildebeests, stoking their cells until the creatures grew large enough to smash through their confinement.

timeline.summary: The freed menagerie stampedes through the gallery and the Royal Palace collapses.
timeline.quote: Soon enough, the Royal Palace fell, dust pluming into the air.

relations.note: rules the Royal Menagerie and the Hall of Treasures
relations.quote: He rules over the Royal Menagerie and the wonders in the Hall of Treasures.

pages_say.description: A vast menagerie of captured wildlife run by the Baron of Vernot.
